_comment: Phase and arm labels from visual inspection; numeric values are regression outputs, not 3D ground truth.
Five-pass quality guards deliberately refuse conflicting readings, even on genuine Trophy photos.
Tolerance detects output drift and is not a calibrated estimator error bound.
The default sample folder is the licensed repository reference-photo set.

cases.pose: ready stance, both hands at the waist
rear view, racket arm fully hidden behind the body
trophy position, racket arm foreshortened toward the camera
follow-through, hitting arm extended across the body
contact, hitting arm fully extended overhead
early backswing, dim photo, racket hand still below the shoulder
trophy position, racket arm foreshortened toward the camera
